title: Cross-check authority stamp STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT is not cleared at pipeline entry, unlike the review slots
evidence:
state_init.py:55-62:
```
_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_KEYS: tuple[str, ...] = (
    STATE_VERIFICATION_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW,
    STATE_FINAL_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW,
    STATE_COMPLIANCE_REPAIR_REQUEST,
    STATE_COMPLIANCE_REPAIR_RESULT,
    STATE_COMPLIANCE_REPAIR_META,
    STATE_COMPLIANCE_JUDGE_META,
)
```
state_init.py:236: `for key in _COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_KEYS: state[key] = ""`
constants.py:83: `STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT = "temp:compliance_review_verdict"`
compliance_enforcement.py:154: "Written on EVERY judge run (pass / fail / unparsable) so the slot always reflects the latest attempt within the invocation."
detail: The stamp the None-review cross-check trusts is omitted from _COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_KEYS, so a prior invocation's clean stamp survives in a persistent session. Traced paths cannot read it harmfully (stamp overwritten every judge run; judge-crash propagates and skips finalize), so defense-in-depth only.
recommended_fix: Add STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT to _COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_KEYS in state_init.py so a stale stamp from a prior invocation can never be read as this run's clean verdict.
